text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr manages to achieve
fantastic
results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Are you looking for Zephyr? I saw
her over
by the park.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
For real, though... You must have your
hands full.
That Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She always gives off a real "free as the
wind" vibe,
y'know? She's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Sigh... I just can't get enough of that airy aura.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Are you letting the breeze
soothe
you as well?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What an opportune airstream. The
rustling in the
wake of the easterly wind
makes me feel like I'm
atop a breath of
fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's achieved a lot over the past three
years.
And while she's obviously had to
grow and adapt,
deep down, she's the
same as she ever was.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You're right. I am the wind, after

all—always around, blowing here and
there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Blowing constantly and freely... to the
ends of the
earth.
